subject: english
prompt: 在2025年4月1日校園圖書館放學後課堂活動中，在「Ad-Ⅳ-1：國中文法句型」能力練習中，Read: 'Nora put the seedlings near the window. After a week, they grew taller.' Why did Nora put them there？

options.text: To hide them in a drawer.

answer.explanation: A window can provide light needed by growing seedlings. 本題對應 KG「Ad-Ⅳ-1：國中文法句型」，情境為2025年4月1日校園圖書館放學後。
